Transportation Emissions

Air pollution caused by emissions from vehicles such as cars, trucks, buses, motorcycles, and, where relevant, ships or planes. Includes both exhaust and resuspended road dust due to traffic.

Industrial and Power Plant Emissions

Air pollution resulting from emissions from factories, manufacturing facilities, industrial fuel combustion, coal-fired power plants, and mining operations. Includes sources outside city boundaries if they impact urban air quality.

Biomass Burning and Agriculture

Air pollution caused by burning of biomass for land clearing, slash-and-burn agriculture, deforestation, and wildfires. Includes cross-border and rural burning that impacts urban air quality.

Household Emissions

Air pollution from household use of fossil fuels or biomass for cooking and heating. More relevant in rural or under-resourced settings, but included if mentioned nationally.

Waste Management and Burning

Air pollution resulting from the open burning of waste, including municipal solid waste, landfill fires, and neighborhood trash burning. Only applies when combustion is explicitly mentioned.

Construction and Dust

Air pollution caused by construction activities, roadworks, and resuspended soil or dust, especially during dry seasons.
